mapper.select: select id from cm_user_goal where user_id=#{userId} and status in ('active', 'paused') order by update_time desc, id desc limit 1
select id from cm_user_goal where user_id=#{userId} and status in ('active', 'paused') order by update_time desc, id desc limit 1 for update

select ec.id certification_id, ec.certification_code, ec.certification_name, sv.id syllabus_version_id, sv.version_name syllabus_version_name from cm_exam_certification ec join lateral ( select id, version_name from cm_syllabus_version where certification_id=ec.id and (published_date <= #{today} or published_date is null) order by (published_date is null) asc, published_date desc nulls last, create_time desc, id desc limit 1 ) sv on true where ec.status='0' order by ec.sort_order, ec.id
select status from cm_exam_certification where id=#{certificationId}

select ec.id certification_id, ec.certification_code, ec.certification_name, sv.id syllabus_version_id, sv.version_name syllabus_version_name from cm_exam_certification ec join lateral ( select id, version_name from cm_syllabus_version where certification_id=ec.id and (published_date <= #{today} or published_date is null) order by (published_date is null) asc, published_date desc nulls last, create_time desc, id desc limit 1 ) sv on true where ec.id=#{certificationId} and ec.status='0'

select g.id, g.certification_id, ec.certification_name, g.syllabus_version_id, sv.version_name syllabus_version_name, g.target_exam_year, g.target_exam_month, g.daily_minutes, g.status, g.row_version,g.exam_batch_type,g.target_exam_date from cm_user_goal g join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=g.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=g.syllabus_version_id where g.id=#{goalId}

select i.payload_hash, i.status, i.resource_id, cast(i.response_body as text) response_body, g.user_id goal_owner_id from cm_idempotency_record i left join cm_user_goal g on g.id=i.resource_id where i.action_code=#{action} and i.request_id=#{requestId}

select 'official' exam_batch_type, schedule.exam_start_date target_exam_date from cm_exam_schedule schedule join cm_exam_period period on period.id=schedule.exam_period_id where schedule.certification_id=#{certificationId} and period.status='published' and period.record_origin='official' and schedule.exam_start_date > #{today} order by schedule.exam_start_date, schedule.id

select g.id,g.certification_id,ec.certification_name,g.syllabus_version_id,sv.version_name syllabus_version_name, g.target_exam_year,g.target_exam_month,g.daily_minutes,g.status,g.row_version,g.exam_batch_type,g.target_exam_date from cm_user_goal g join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=g.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=g.syllabus_version_id where g.user_id=#{userId} and g.status='active'

select g.id,g.certification_id,ec.certification_name,g.syllabus_version_id,sv.version_name syllabus_version_name, g.target_exam_year,g.target_exam_month,g.daily_minutes,g.status,g.row_version,g.exam_batch_type,g.target_exam_date from cm_user_goal g join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=g.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=g.syllabus_version_id where g.user_id=#{userId} and g.status='active' for update of g

select s.id,s.session_type,coalesce(t.display_snapshot->>'title', case s.session_type when 'initial_diagnosis' then '首次诊断' when 'self_practice' then '知识点练习' when 'task_test' then '任务测验' when 'simulation' then '模拟考试' when 'correction' then '错题订正' when 'independent_verification' then '独立验证' when 'simulation_verification' then '模拟考试验证' else '每日任务' end) title,s.status from cm_learning_session s left join cm_learning_task t on t.id=s.source_task_id where s.goal_id=#{goalId} and s.status in ('created','in_progress') order by s.create_time,s.id
select s.id,s.session_type,'待放弃会话' title,s.status from cm_learning_session s where s.goal_id=#{goalId} and s.status in ('created','in_progress') order by s.create_time,s.id for update
mapper.update: update cm_learning_session set status='cancelled',status_reason='goal_switched',status_changed_by=#{operatorId}, status_changed_time=now(),update_time=now() where goal_id=#{goalId} and status in ('created','in_progress')
update cm_user_goal set status='paused',row_version=row_version+1,update_time=now() where id=#{goalId} and status='active' and row_version=#{expectedVersion}
